description: Orb Studio radar stories of the last 14 days: the share with none of the passport content lines (not_event, vague, quoted, found_document, extraordinary, rumour_risk, poll, metaphor, tone, state_media, amplified), per radar and per day, with the lines that fire most and a sample of silent headlines. Silent means no rule matched, not that the story was checked; an ordinary event can be rightly silent. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of W. Ross Ashby (1903-1972), author of the law of requisite variety.
name: get_ashby
title: Ashby sensor: on what share of radar stories does the news passport have no line about what the headline says
